newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Carryover demand seen and crop report supportive to nearbys.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Index up, bearish crop report and technically strong. New contract highs likely.
HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Higher cash hog calls and bearish crop report. But premium will limit gains.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Oversold Monday, cash firm and out-of-town report seen showing light storings.
